_meta.source: Kusumgar curated association list — the industry bodies Kusumgar should join / attend, per segment
_meta.note: verified=false rows await the associations robot (scripts/refresh-associations.mjs) — it reads each body's OWN website and fills next_event / membership_note from that page text only; nothing is invented.

associations.name: Advanced Textiles Association
associations.why_relevant: The primary specialty- and technical-fabrics trade body (formerly IFAI). Its members and the Advanced Textiles Expo span coated/technical fabrics, marine canvas, protective covers, awnings and bags — Kusumgar's core segments.
associations.membership_note: Memberships start at under $50/month and provide access to join 1,400+ member companies serving the advanced textiles industry.

associations.name: Industrial Fabrics Association International
associations.why_relevant: The industrial/technical fabrics association now operating under the Advanced Textiles Association — the network for coated and industrial-fabric producers, buyers and fabricators.
associations.membership_note: Memberships start at under $50/month and provide access to industry-specific education, valuable connections, sourcing opportunities, and support on the federal and state level.

associations.name: Marine Fabricators Association
associations.why_relevant: A division of ATA/IFAI representing roughly 300 marine canvas fabricators (boat covers, biminis, enclosures) — the direct buyer community for marine cover fabrics.
associations.membership_note: To become a member, first join the Advanced Textiles Association, then gain access to the Marine Fabricators Association member group for benefits including industry resources, educational materials, member directory access, and discounted event attendance.

associations.name: EDANA
associations.why_relevant: The leading European (and Middle East / Africa) nonwovens and related-industries association — hygiene, medical and wipes producers; the network for medical and emergency nonwoven fabrics.
associations.membership_note: EDANA welcomes businesses across the nonwovens value chain and offers exclusive market data, industry intelligence, and tailored services to support member organizations' growth and competitiveness.

associations.name: INDA — Association of the Nonwoven Fabrics Industry
associations.why_relevant: The North American nonwovens association (host of the IDEA show) — medical, hygiene and technical nonwovens producers and buyers.
associations.membership_note: INDA serves hundreds of member companies across the nonwovens and engineered fabrics industry, helping members convene and connect, innovate, and grow through industry-leading events, professional development courses, market intelligence, test methods, consulting services, and advocacy.
associations.next_event: Webinar: Professional Cleaning Wipes: Voice of Customer Insights

associations.name: Parachute Industry Association
associations.why_relevant: The global body for parachute and aerial-delivery manufacturers — a direct fit for Kusumgar's parachute-fabric heritage and defence/aeronautical textiles.
associations.membership_note: PIA welcomes members from every aspect of the parachute business, including suppliers, manufacturers, government agencies, industry-relevant businesses, riggers and DZOs, and interested individuals can see their Membership Application to join.

associations.name: National Defense Industrial Association
associations.why_relevant: The largest US defence-industry association — the route into military & defence textile programs, primes and procurement events.
associations.membership_note: NDIA is a membership-driven association where members can join through membership options, access member resources, and participate in chapters led by volunteer leaders with deep knowledge of local defense ecosystems.

associations.name: Outdoor Industry Association
associations.why_relevant: The US outdoor-products trade body (packs, bags and outdoor gear) — relevant to technical bag fabrics and outdoor-cover materials.
associations.membership_note: OIA membership brings organizations together to shape the future of the outdoor industry with access to advocacy, sustainability resources, business intelligence, and a community of leaders and innovators.

associations.name: Pool & Hot Tub Alliance
associations.why_relevant: The US pool & spa industry body — the buyer community for pool safety covers and winter cover fabrics.
associations.membership_note: Members can join a powerful network of pool and hot tub professionals with exclusive benefits, industry insights, and advocacy support.

associations.name: International Association for Healthcare Textile Management
associations.why_relevant: The network for healthcare laundry and reusable medical textiles — relevant to medical & emergency fabric applications.
associations.membership_note: IAHTM provides shared learning opportunities and educational programs to senior-level experts and their peers in healthcare textile management, with benefits including learning from industry experts, sharing insights, and connecting with peers across North America.

associations.name: Association for Contract Textiles
associations.why_relevant: Sets voluntary standards for commercial/contract interior textiles (upholstery, healthcare and seating fabrics) — relevant to seating and healthcare interior applications.
associations.membership_note: ACT member companies include Principal Members and Associate Members who are companies and individuals involved in the design, development, production, promotion and application of textiles for commercial environments, supporting the standards and initiatives of ACT.

associations.name: The Textile Institute
associations.why_relevant: The global professional body for textiles (UK-based, worldwide membership) — standards, qualifications and conferences spanning technical and medical textiles.
associations.membership_note: By joining the TI, members gain access to a global network, can apply for professional qualifications, receive discounts on publications, attend events and training courses, and access industry news and job opportunities.

associations.name: Indian Technical Textile Association
associations.why_relevant: Represents the technical textile industry in India covering all 13 segments including composites, with nearly 400 members representing the entire technical textile value chain from raw material to finished goods producers, machinery manufacturers, consultants, centers of excellence and R&D/Academic
associations.membership_note: ITTA offers three types of membership: Primary/Patron, Associate, and Student, with nearly 400 members representing the entire technical textile value chain from raw material to finished goods producers, machinery manufacturers, consultants, centers of excellence and R&D/Academic institutions.

associations.name: National Council of Textile Organizations
associations.why_relevant: Represents the entire spectrum of the U.S. textile industry including manufacturers across the full textile supply chain.
associations.membership_note: NCTO represents the entire spectrum of the textile industry and offers membership to those interested in joining the voice of U.S. textiles in Washington.
